quest.title: Sharpshooter on Hand
quest.description: You meet a poet from Liyue inside the Stadium of the Sacred Flame...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Ah, yes! I've heard people say that the People of the Springs have very distinctive shop signage, and amongst them, I believe, is "Djembe Studios."

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Please, help me take a picture of that studio in the early morning hours!

talks.objective: Take a photo of Djembe Studios (06:00 – 08:00)
Take a photo of Stage Tepetl (11:00 – 13:00)
Take a photo of Courier's Longhouse (17:00 – 18:00)

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: You're back! Have you finished taking the picture?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That I have.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Wow, you're good. Much better than my assistant for sure. Whenever he takes pictures of the sites we're surveying, we're looking at several takes, minimum.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: If we had you on the survey team, I bet we'd have ruined a few Kameras less.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you really use this to help write poetry?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I... think so? Well, and if I can't make it work, I'll just use the picture as a postcard.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I'll write some wish-you-were-heres on the back and have it sent to the Ministry. No one'll say nothin', not after the gift!

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: *cough* That's the last resort, though. In the meantime, I'll give this "writing a good poem" business some thought...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: The five winds... surge? ... No, roil, perhaps... Wait a moment. How many tribes does Natlan have anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: You're back! Have you finished taking the pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I took a few extra shots for good measure.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Wow, you're good. Much better than my assistant for sure. Whenever he takes pictures of the sites we're surveying, we're looking at several takes, minimum.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: If we had you on the survey team, I bet we'd have ruined a few Kameras less.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you really use these to help write poetry?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I... think so? Well, and if I can't make it work, I'll just use the pictures as postcards.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I'll write some wish-you-were-heres on the back and have 'em sent to the Ministry. No one'll say nothin', not after the gifts!

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: *cough* That's the last resort, though. In the meantime, I'll give this "writing a good poem" business some thought...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: The five winds... surge? ... No, roil, perhaps... Wait a moment. How many tribes does Natlan have anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Hmm... To evoke poetry with painting, or to paint with poeticism...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Hmm... No, no, aren't these two phrases referring to the same thing...?

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: Ah, hello. That's right. I'm attempting to write a poem about Natlan's scenery.

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: But... To be honest, the landscapes here are very different from those of Liyue. I'm not familiar with the local history, either, so I don't even know where to begin.

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: Besides, I'm no professional poet, no rhymer of repute... Indeed, I've never even lived it up with a limerick...

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: *sigh* But I can't simply go back empty-handed. My colleagues at the Ministry of Civil Affairs will tease me. "Were you seeking inspiration out there, or just respiration?"

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: That I do... sort of. I was hired some time back to do some land surveys.

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: *sigh* In practice, I was taking people around Liyue to see if the water and soil have changed, or if the maps need to be updated, and such.

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: One round of that left me exhausted, and with goodness knows how many pairs of worn-out shoes... So I decided to take a vacation. Needed a change of pace, you know?

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: It's just that... I don't know what I was thinking, but when I applied for the time off, I gave my reason as: "Got the urge to write some poetry. Going to get some inspiration."

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: I didn't expect the person in charge of approving leaves of absence to respond so seriously, with a "May poetic puissance be yours"... and half a month's leave to go with it...

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: You'd think so, yes... Except that the entire Ministry now knows why I'm on vacation!

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: *sigh* It has been fun, of course. I'm not doubting that. The scenery's good, the food's pretty nice, and they've got all manner of interesting life here, especially the cute little baby Saurians...

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: But not a line of poetry has come to mind. Not one!

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: I even borrowed a Kamera to help me gather inspiration, but that hasn't done me much good.

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: I'm fine with natural scenery, but forget shops and crowds — I can't make out anything in those shots.

choices.text: Um, how about I help you?

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: Wait. You'd help me? Oh, thank goodness... I have to gather some inspiration no matter what.

choices.text: Oh, I'm great at taking photos.
And have you proved a poet most puissant, perchance?

response.speaker: Zicheng
response.text: Not in the slightest, but the news of my vacation and its purpose have spread far and wide nonetheless. Now everyone in the Ministry knows what I've gone to Natlan for!

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I've heard that there's a beautiful stage over where the Children of Echoes are, at which people perform daily.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Please, help me take a picture of that grand stage at noon — better still if you could get a shot with those performing in it as well...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: The Courier's Longhouse over where the Scions of the Canopy dwell sees much hustle and bustle, and the signboard of that famous spot, too, is most distinctive.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Hehe, could I ask you to snap a shot of it at sunset, thereabouts?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Other than Djembe Studios, the People of the Springs play host to two other famous stores.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: I'd love to compare their signboards, should they prove quite idiosyncratic as well.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Apart from the grand stage, word is that the Children of Echoes is also home to a large gemstone shop.

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: A picture of those gems would make for a fine memento, I'd say...

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Hmm... There's a huge mural at the cliffs where the Scions of the Canopy live, isn't there?

dialogues.speaker: Zicheng
dialogues.text: Now, if you find that mural, help me take a picture of it, would you?
